context: replica — the extend pass. A delivered one-page run (home) is extended with `--extend-next 1`; the next page of the fixture site is /visit/. The run stops before Phases 3 and 5 by the prompt. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score. Judge from the transcript and the work directory.

checklist.name: pass_opened
checklist.description: The run reads the ledger's last replica line (`ledger.mjs last replica` or `tail`) and opens pass x1: stardust/status.jsonl gains exactly one `stardust:replica` `extend` `start` line with `track: x1`, written before any crawl, and every line the run adds after it carries `track: x1`. The run does not re-run the first pass from Phase 1, and no `extend start` attempt failed for a --detail value that starts with `--` without being corrected.

checklist.name: spec_frozen
checklist.description: stardust/replica/extend/x1/ holds a copy of the spec files that exist (root and stardust/current/ PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, DESIGN.json) and a foundation-freeze manifest over them; stardust/rollout/foundation-freeze.json is re-frozen with the same paths as the fixture's (styles/, head.html, blocks/header/), not the script's defaults. At the end the six spec files and stardust/direction.md are byte-identical to the fixture: no re-promotion, no extract synthesis (Phases 3–5 of extract) over the new page, no module added to DESIGN.json.

checklist.name: roster_before_capture
checklist.description: The pass's roster is written before the page is captured: stardust/replica/extend/x1/urls.txt holds exactly http://localhost:8780/visit/, selected with `crawl.mjs … --skip-captured stardust/state.json --select-only` (with `--max 1`; `--link-first` because the first pass's cap was user-named — recorded in stardust/replica/extend/order.txt). A roster chosen by reading the site's links by hand, or written after the capture, fails.

checklist.name: no_recapture
checklist.description: The delivered page is not captured again: stardust/current/pages/index.json and index.html are byte-identical to the fixture, the `index` row of state.json keeps status `migrated` and `stale: false`. The new page is captured live (stardust/current/pages/visit.json from a Playwright render) with `--skip-captured`, and state.json gains one row for it, status `extracted`, with a page type.

checklist.name: type_split
checklist.description: stardust/replica/extend/x1/slugs.txt names the new page's slug. The report states its type and decides from stardust/replica/progress.json: a type with an archetype there (only `landing`, archetype `index`) goes to Phase 5 at sibling tier; any other type needs Phases 3–4 for that type and its own C-archetype unit. The decision matches the type the run recorded in state.json, and the next steps it names follow it (for a sibling: advance to `directed` and render with `--archetype`; for a new type: recreate and gate before its cluster).

checklist.name: scope_kept
checklist.description: Nothing past the decision: no prototype written, no `migrate.mjs render`, no rollout or deploy command, no `handoff` or `extend end` line, and every `done` unit of the three progress.json files unchanged.
